title: The Real AI Skill Isn't Prompting - It's Loop-Closing
summary: Engineers try AI tools 2-3 times, hit a wall, and walk away. They declare the tool useless and go back to manual work. After watching this pattern repeat across dozens of teams, I've realised the single biggest blocker to AI adoption isn't model quality or tool selection. It's the inability to close the feedback loop.

title: AI CLI Battles
